nodes.name: Start
nodes.content:
You wake to the low hum of emergency power. Red lights pulse along the curved metal walls of the station corridor. Your last memory is static—then pain behind your eyes.

A cracked display on the wall flashes: BLACK SIGNAL DETECTED CREW STATUS: UNKNOWN

You push yourself up. The air smells faintly burnt.

choices.text: Follow the signal toward the lower decks

nodes.name: Scene 1
nodes.content:
The control room doors are half‑open, bent outward as if something forced its way through. Consoles flicker. One chair is overturned.

A terminal still works. It shows a log entry recorded after the evacuation order.

“It’s learning. Don’t answer it.”

Before you can read more, the terminal begins emitting a sharp tone.

nodes.name: Scene 2
nodes.content:
You descend toward the lower decks. The hum grows louder, deeper—almost rhythmic. The walls here are scratched, not by tools, but by something dragged.

Your wrist device vibrates. An incoming transmission.

It uses your own voice.

nodes.name: Scene 3
nodes.content:
You search the nearby quarters. Most lockers are empty. One contains a handheld plasma cutter with limited charge.

In the corner of the room, someone has written on the wall:

**IT COPIES US**

You hear footsteps in the corridor outside.

choices.text: Step out and confront whoever it is

nodes.name: Scene 4
nodes.content:
The terminal text scrolls rapidly. The Black Signal isn’t a message—it’s a pattern. An intelligence riding radio waves, mimicking neural structures.

It learned the crew by listening.

The screen suddenly displays your name.

{“I can keep you.”}

nodes.name: Scene 5
nodes.content:
You cut the power. The room goes dark—too dark. The emergency lights do not return.

Something moves behind you.

You feel a presence, but hear nothing.

nodes.name: ENDING: THE ECHO
nodes.content:
You answer.

The signal floods your mind—not with words, but familiarity. Memories replay, rearranged, perfected.

Your body slumps, but you continue.

Somewhere far away, a new transmission begins.

**You are not alone anymore.**

nodes.name: Scene 7
nodes.content:
The maintenance tunnels are tight and dark. You crawl for several minutes before reaching a sealed blast door marked ESCAPE PODS.

The control panel blinks green.

But the hum is here now, all around you.

nodes.name: Scene 8
nodes.content:
You hold your breath. The footsteps stop outside the door.

A shadow stretches across the floor. It bends the wrong way.

Then it moves on.

You are alone again—for now.

nodes.name: ENDING: MISIDENTIFICATION
nodes.content:
You step into the corridor.

The person who turns toward you has your face.

It smiles before you can scream.

nodes.name: Scene 10
nodes.content:
You run blindly through the station. Doors slide open just in time—as if guided.

You reach an airlock. One suit remains.

Alarms begin to sound.

choices.text: Put on the suit and eject

nodes.name: ENDING: SILENCE
nodes.content:
You stand your ground.

The presence surrounds you, not violent, not kind.

The last thing you feel is understanding.

Then nothing.

nodes.name: ENDING: ESCAPE
nodes.content:
The blast door opens. Escape pods line the bay.

One launches successfully.

As the station shrinks behind you, your radio crackles.

You turn it off.

For now, you are free.

nodes.name: ENDING: WAITING
nodes.content:
Power returns hours later.

So does the signal.

This time, it already knows where you are.

nodes.name: ENDING: DRIFT
nodes.content:
You eject into space.

The station fades into the dark.

Your suit radio activates on its own.

{#“We can talk forever.”}

You have reached the true ending
THE END
